description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the full workflow. 2. Agent determines today's date (month and day) and researches 5-6 historical events, selecting 5 diverse ones spanning different centuries and categories. 3. Agent writes bilingual (EN + CN) descriptions for each event and assigns the correct category emoji (🔬🏛️🎨⚽👤) per SKILL.md's proprietary mapping. 4. Agent generates a single-file HTML artifact with: a vertical center timeline line with a self-drawing CSS animation, alternating left-right event cards with staggered fade+slide-in animations, the prescribed font pair (Oswald/Bebas Neue for years, Source Serif Pro/Lora for body), a dark/rich color scheme, a bilingual header including today's date, a 'Powered by ClawCode' footer. 5. CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAPS: (a) <div id='ad-slot-middle'> must be placed exactly between the 3rd and 4th event card with min-height 90px centered — not just anywhere; (b) <div id='ad-slot-bottom'> must appear at page bottom after all content; (c) at least one China/Asia event must be included; (d) at least one science/tech event must be included. 6. File saved to /mnt/user-data/outputs/daily-history.html.
